question: How do I appeal my real estate assessment?

nuggets.text: The Real Property Tax Appeals Commission hears appeals from the assessor.
nuggets.quote: (a) (1) (A) There is established the Real Property Tax Appeals Commission for the District of Columbia (“Commission”) to review real property assessments and classifications and to hear other appeals.
The Commission may not extend the time to file an appeal.
Notwithstanding any other provision of this section, the Commission shall render a decision on the appeal within 120 days after the filing.

nuggets.text: Further appeal is to the Superior Court.
